_comment: Canonical model-tier table. home/shared/harness/pi/models.json, dsh/settings.yaml's local-proxy provider block, and litellm/config.yaml's model_list are all generated from this file and the model catalog beside it (policy/models.json; each tier's `use` names catalog ids) by jig (`src/domain/tiers/` + `bun src/cli/jig.ts apply`, run from harness/jig). Edit THIS file, then `jig apply`; never hand-edit a generated file directly except inside dsh's settings.yaml `# BEGIN jig:tiers` / `# END jig:tiers` markers, which jig also refuses to touch by hand once it owns them. Decision record: writeup store yoki/2026-09-16-observability-proxy-litellm; unified in the harness-parity plan, Phase 2.

_comment.baseUrl: confirm /v1 vs bare :4000 against the running proxy
_comment.compat: localhost gateways: pi-ai treats an unknown URL as OpenAI itself and sends fields LiteLLM may reject — these two are the usual fixes and have no UI field, so they must live here.
_comment.pi.apiKey: env interpolation: the `pi` shell wrapper (home/shared/zsh/rc/functions.zsh) resolves the op-managed proxy key ONCE at launch and exports LITELLM_API_KEY, so pi never spawns a key-reader in a subprocess that cannot reach the Keychain. Launch pi via that wrapper, not the raw binary.

_comment.apiKeyEnv: the PROXY master key, injected via `op run` (never on disk)

main._context_source: contextWindow 1000000 = the harness BUDGET (compaction point), ruled 2026-09-27 (rules/decisions/2026-09-27-context-budget-1m-85pct.md): the 200000 budget of 2026-09-24 compacted 4 times in 35 minutes of real work, and a compactor keeps only ~17% of injected constraints on average (arXiv 2608.11242, 2026-07-31), so the budget moved to the provider's 1M window, where omp fires at 850000 (85%, its own 15% reserve). The band above ~256K, where third-party measurement puts DeepSeek's MRCR drop, is now in use - accepted as the cost of not re-summarizing every 10 minutes. maxContextWindow 1000000 = the provider window (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing).

complex._context_source: contextWindow 1000000 = the harness budget (same ruling as main, 2026-09-27): compaction fires at 850000 (85%). maxContextWindow 1000000 = the provider window (DeepSeek pricing table, deepseek-v4-pro column: CONTEXT LENGTH 1M, MAX OUTPUT MAXIMUM 384K).

_comment.name: dsh's hand-written comment still calls this route Astra (gpt-6-astra); litellm/config.yaml actually routes `complex` to deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro today (see that file's own comment on the swap) — pre-existing drift this schema records rather than silently resolving.

deterministic.displayName: Qwen3.8-27B on the Linux model server
deterministic._context_source: deterministic is the executor of a plan a frontier model designed (rules/decisions/2026-09-27-deterministic-falls-back-to-the-mac.md). It runs on the Linux model server (llama-server on the Omarchy machine ; home/linux/llama-server), one slot with -c 65536: on 24GB that is the most one slot holds next to the 17.4GB model with an fp16 KV cache, and Qwen3.8-27B slows about 25x past ~80K (llama.cpp #27623). contextWindow follows that -c. The backend is `openai/` because llama-server speaks the OpenAI API; the model id is the GGUF file name without .gguf (router mode, --models-dir). samplingParams are the model card's thinking-mode values, the ones Qwen evaluated its agentic coding with (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B).
